news: Cohorts
Cohort 7 opens with twelve world builders
Twelve teams join the autumn speedrun, from a floating bazaar in Aria to a night ferry that links three club cities.
Rounds
Satin Swans close a 1.2M SUM community round
The club sold out its first round in four hours. Members voted to spend half on a new runway hall in Brocade.
Treasury
Reward weights move toward hosting
Hosting a meetup now earns more SUM than flipping a PFT, after a Phidao vote passed with 71 percent.
Demo day
Demo day returns to the Atelier Nine dome
Nine teams pitch live to members on November 14. Every member can back a team with as little as 10 SUM.
Registry
Forty new functions join the registry
Quest scoring, ride booking and look fitting are now logged functions with their own rewards.
Stories
How the Velvet Pack paid for its own city
A club of ninety members turned weekly runway nights into a treasury large enough to fund a district.
Rounds
Lantern Row raises for a market street
The market team wants stalls that change with the season. Their round closes on October 30.
Treasury
Quarterly report: inflows up 18 percent
Most new SUM came from ride fees and hosted events. Spending stayed inside the budget the DAO set.
Cohorts
Mentors announced for the speedrun
Builders from Phipad, Phiora and four founding clubs will hold weekly office hours.
Stories
A tailor in Cashmere Peaks earns her first 10k SUM
Fitting looks for other members is a logged function. Mira did 400 fittings in a month.
Registry
Schemas get versions
Every function now carries a version, so old logs keep paying out the way they did when you ran them.
Rounds
Chiffon Heights club applies for matching
The club asks the fund to match member pledges one to one up to 500k SUM.

faq.q: Can I back a cohort team?
faq.a: Yes. Open the team on demo day and pledge any amount of SUM from your wallet.
At the start of each month, for every function logged in the month before.
The cohort team scores each project, then members vote on the shortlist.
Clubs apply the same way as teams. The club treasury signs the application.
Ten SUM. There is no maximum, but rounds close when the target is met.
